title: Playoffs follow-ups: Back replaces history, docs wording and totals
request: Follow-up to the Back to brackets task. Doug said yes to: (1) use replace instead of push when a bracket is closed, so the phone Back button does not re-open it; (4) fix the small docs wording nits and the stale checklist totals in verification/README.md.

criteria.text: Closing a bracket uses a history REPLACE, not a push, on every route that closes one (the Back to brackets button, the error banner button, and deleting a bracket). Opening a bracket still pushes. A hook test for each is written first (RED, then GREEN).

Real browser proof of the history stack with the fake data (390 px, touch): open the list, open a bracket, press Back to brackets, then press the browser Back. Report the URL after each step. Also the direct-link case (open /playoffs?bracket=<id> first). Report the real behaviour honestly, including any extra Back step.

Docs follow the code: the cache time limit (a bracket stays cached 5 minutes after its last use), the scroll sentence, the pill wording in the Playoffs page row and in checklist rows PLAYOFF-25 and PLAYOFF-29 (a dot on a phone), the Loading bracket banner wording, one line in read-a-bracket.md about the new spinner, and the history behaviour (state diagram, Cancel and interrupt rows, a checklist row). Every sentence checked against the code.
The totals in docs/product-description/verification/README.md are recounted with a script and match the checklist files. The counting method is stated in the commit.

Two code comments are corrected to match the code: SeasonSelector.tsx (it says the component is mounted twice; check what is true) and PlayoffView.tsx (the Loading bracket banner is the only banner with a Back button).

Nothing else changes: existing playoff tests pass, no test is skipped or weakened, and the real tap test still works (open a bracket, press Back to brackets, the list shows, the address loses bracket=).
All required repo checks pass on the final commit and a fresh independent reviewer approves it. Left alone and reported.
